create_ocr_factory: create an OcrFactory instance to manage and instantiate OCR engine plugins
build_ocr_factory_register: build an OcrFactory and register an OCR model class with its options type and plugin metadata
run_ocr_factory_create_instance: run the OcrFactory create_instance method to instantiate an OCR model from pipeline options
run_ocr_factory_load_from_plugins: run the OcrFactory load_from_plugins method to discover and register OCR engines from setuptools entry points
review_ocr_factory_get_enum: review the OcrFactory get_enum method to generate an enum of all registered OCR engine kinds
